name: llm_dp
description: Prompted LLM discourse parser (molweni_dp): shows the numbered EDUs and the relation label set, asks for the full [x, y, relation] edge list as JSON; scored by discourse_relation_f1. Falls back to the dp_previous_edu chain for any EDU the model leaves unattached, so every EDU gets exactly one parent. Defaults to the free local google/gemma-4-31B-it.
author: Wnsdnl
